verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows that Secureframe lets users version, review, or roll back their own automations. The closest items are adjacent features that earn no credit. The drift log's retain/revert applies to monitored Azure Government resources, not automations. The dated API versioning policy covers Secureframe's own API releases, not user-defined workflows. Policy 'date modified' attributes and vendor history logs track documents and vendors, not automation configurations.
